heading: Frequently asked questions
intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and a real person will get back to you within a day.

content.text: Orders ship within two business days and arrive in 3–5 days for most of the country. You'll get a tracking link by email the moment it leaves our workshop.
We accept returns within 30 days of delivery, no questions asked. Items should be unused and in their original packaging.
Yes — we currently ship to Canada, the UK and the EU. Rates and delivery times are calculated at checkout.
